journal.attuned.title: Attunement Journal
journal.attuned.screen.title: Attunement Journal
journal.attuned.screen.subtitle: Foci, pacts, altar craft
journal.attuned.line1: Foci work only while equipped and inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.line2: Slot order is priority: higher slots wake first when capacity is tight.
journal.attuned.line3: Eight affinities form a counter wheel; each beats two and is countered by two. See the journal matchup pages.
journal.attuned.line4: Mixing active affinities creates Discord: more damage dealt and taken.
journal.attuned.line5: Pacts wake at three Foci. Apex wakes near full capacity through commitment, Discord, or a neutral path.
journal.attuned.line6: Bind shards at an Attunement Altar, and craft four fragments into one shard.
journal.attuned.line7: The Unseen reward stillness, shadows, and openings rather than raw force.
journal.attuned.line8: Foci and shard fragments are found through vanilla loot, including Lootr-style chests.
journal.attuned.page1:
Attunement Journal

Equip Foci in the side slots of your inventory.

A Focus only works while it is awake inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.page2:
Priority

Higher Focus slots wake first.

If your total cost is too high, lower slots go dormant before higher slots.
journal.attuned.page3:
Capacity

Capacity is your build budget.

Bind Attunement Shards at an Altar to raise it, up to the server's cap.
journal.attuned.page4:
Affinities

Eight affinities form a counter wheel. Each one beats two others and is countered by two. The next pages record every matchup.

Neutral Foci fit any build.
journal.attuned.page34:
Affinity Wheel

Every affinity is a first-class identity on the counter wheel.

Focus tooltips name only the affinity. The journal records who each affinity beats and who answers it.
journal.attuned.page35:
Affinity Matchups I

Fury: beats Bastion, Verdant; weak to Holy, Tide.
Bastion: beats Zephyr, Umbral; weak to Fury, Forge.
Zephyr: beats Holy, Tide; weak to Bastion, Umbral.
Holy: beats Fury, Umbral; weak to Zephyr, Verdant.
journal.attuned.page36:
Affinity Matchups II

Tide: beats Fury, Forge; weak to Zephyr, Verdant.
Forge: beats Bastion, Verdant; weak to Tide, Umbral.
Verdant: beats Tide, Holy; weak to Fury, Forge.
Umbral: beats Zephyr, Forge; weak to Bastion, Holy.
journal.attuned.page5:
Discord

Using two or more active affinities creates Discord.

You deal more damage, but you also take more damage. You earn half Resonance from Resonant Surges.
journal.attuned.page6:
Pacts

Three active Foci of one affinity can awaken a Pact.

Pacts reward committing to a lane instead of wearing every trick at once.
journal.attuned.page7:
Apex

Four active Foci near full capacity can reach Apex.

Each committed affinity wakes its own capstone: Execute, Unyielding, Untouchable, Judgment, Riptide, Crucible, Bloomward, or Gloaming. Build combat resonance to arm them.
journal.attuned.page8:
Shards and Altars

Four Shard Fragments craft into one Attunement Shard.

Place a shard in the Altar and press Bind.
journal.attuned.page9:
The Unseen

These Foci favor quiet movement, smoke, veils, and ambush openings.

They are a faction, not an affinity lane.
journal.attuned.page10:
Finding Foci

Attuned adds Foci and shard fragments to vanilla loot: structures, fishing treasure, archaeology, and trial rewards.

Lootr chests use the same chest tables.
journal.attuned.page11:
First Builds

At capacity 4, keep it plain.

Swift and Leap make a travel kit. Harvest and Nightgaze make a calm work kit. Vital can stand alone.
journal.attuned.page12:
Capacity 6

Try Iron and Emberward for a Bastion guard.

Edge and Frenzy favor Fury raids.

Swift, Leap, and Softstep suit Zephyr roads.
journal.attuned.page13:
Adjusting

If a Focus sleeps, move it to a higher slot or lower the cost.

Bind shards for more capacity. Neutral Foci are easiest to fit.
journal.attuned.page_tempering:
Tempering

Place two identical Foci in an Altar of Reweaving alongside the usual ritual.

The result is Tempered: +25% modifier strength and +1 attunement cost.
journal.attuned.page14:
Altar Memory

Altars bind shards and return anything left inside when closed.

Their glow remembers the last bound affinity. Candles and amethyst only change the ritual's look.
journal.attuned.page15:
Pyresworn Pact

Three active Fury Foci awaken Pyresworn.

Melee hits can ignite foes. Try Edge, Frenzy, and another Fury Focus.
journal.attuned.page16:
Stoneheart Pact

Three active Bastion Foci awaken Stoneheart.

Incoming damage is dulled. Try Iron, Emberward, and Vital.
journal.attuned.page17:
Windrunner Pact

Three active Zephyr Foci awaken Windrunner.

You sprint faster and step over short rises. Try Swift, Leap, and Softstep.
journal.attuned.page29:
Radiant Covenant

Three active Holy Foci awaken Radiant Covenant.

Charged melee hits reveal visible threats. Against undead, the wound deepens only slightly.
journal.attuned.page37:
Tidesworn Pact

Three active Tide Foci awaken Tidesworn.

The current marks you. Try Undertow, Riptide Heart, and Pearlguard.
journal.attuned.page38:
Forgebound Pact

Three active Forge Foci awaken Forgebound.

The ember marks you. Try Slagbrand, Anvilheart, and Sparkweld.
journal.attuned.page39:
Wildroot Pact

Three active Verdant Foci awaken Wildroot.

The wild growth roots you. Try Thornwake, Seedcall, and Bramblegate.
journal.attuned.page40:
Nightsworn Pact

Three active Umbral Foci awaken Nightsworn.

The shadow swallows you. Try Nullveil, Cinderthief, and Snaremoon.
journal.attuned.page18:
Untethered Pact

Four or more different affinity lanes awaken Untethered, as long as no lane reaches three active Foci.

You hit affinity-bearing foes harder, but the pattern is harder to hold.
journal.attuned.page19:
Discord

Discord is a risky stance, not a mistake.

Mixed affinities raise damage dealt and taken. Use it for short aggressive fights, then settle into a Pact when you want stability.
journal.attuned.page30:
Maelstrom Apex

Run four or more different affinity lanes near full capacity, with no lane stacked three deep, to wake Maelstrom.

At resonance, direct hits bite harder and scramble struck affinity foes.
journal.attuned.page31:
Stillpoint Apex

Run four or more neutral Foci near full capacity to wake Stillpoint.

At resonance, affinity pressure is denied and combat can pulse Absorption.
journal.attuned.page41:
Affinity Capstones

The four newer committed lanes each arm an on-hit capstone:

Riptide (Tide): drags foes into the current.
Crucible (Forge): sears foes with forge-heat.
Bloomward (Verdant): returns life to you.
Gloaming (Umbral): saps a foe's strength.
journal.attuned.page42:
Pact Tacticals

Focus Ability key. Priority: ability Focus, Pact tactical, Apex identity.

Crouch to overcharge Pact tacticals by spending resonance.
journal.attuned.page43:
Pact Trials

Trial progress accrues only while that Pact is awake.

Finishing a Trial unlocks a permanent Tier 4 bonus when you re-awaken that Pact.
journal.attuned.page44:
Resonant Surges

During a thunderstorm, a Resonant Surge can call fighters to a storm site.

Stand in the storm to gain Resonance; Discord builds earn half Resonance. Kills there can return shard fragments.
journal.attuned.page45:
Updraft Focus

With an elytra equipped, hold jump while gliding to boost forward.

Hold sprint/control to brake. Long PvP chases trigger PvP exhaustion.
journal.attuned.page46:
Circles

A Circle is a small temporary party for an expedition.

It has no item sharing. Membership is server-authoritative: clients ask, the server decides.
journal.attuned.page47:
Public Attunement State

Circle HUD may show public attunement state: member name, stance, role label, and active or dormant summary.

It never shows exact hidden inventory or cooldowns.
journal.attuned.page48:
Roles, Not Classes

Foci can suggest roles like scout, anchor, witness, or support.

Roles are guidance, not locks. Swap builds when the Circle needs it.
journal.attuned.page49:
Shared Credit

Shared progress is for nearby contributors: fighting, blocking, revealing, or helping a member who just contributed.

Standing nearby should not farm progress.
journal.attuned.page50:
Counter-Wheel Teamwork

Complementary affinities cover each other's weak lanes. A Tide scout and Bastion anchor solve different problems.

Coordinate; do not stack one aura.
journal.attuned.page51:
Party Confluences

Future linked Confluences may ask multiple Circle members to align builds.

They are coordination moments, not passive buffs. Solo play remains complete.
journal.attuned.page52:
Deep Lanterns

Deep Lanterns are a faction, not an affinity. They keep caves readable, mark same-dimension routes, and help a drowning Circle member breathe.

The Attunement Sanctum is their first world clue: look for lanterns, depth, and rescue-light.
journal.attuned.page20:
The Altar of Reweaving

Some altars do not deepen the soul's room.

They turn an old pattern until it catches the light differently.
journal.attuned.page21:
What Reweaving Is Not

Reweaving does not make a Focus louder, stronger, or freer.

It changes the way a bound pattern is remembered.
journal.attuned.page22:
Altar Memory

Every altar keeps a trace of what was last bound there.

Reweaving listens to that trace before it answers.
journal.attuned.page23:
The Radiant

The Radiant keep vows in light.

They believe power is safest when named, witnessed, and remembered.
journal.attuned.page24:
The Unseen

The Unseen keep masks and hidden roads.

They believe power is safest when no one can claim or own it.
journal.attuned.page25:
Witness and Veil

Radiant and Unseen oppose each other like lantern and shadow.

Both exist to keep attunement from becoming careless.
journal.attuned.page26:
The Seafarers

The Seafarers carry fragments, journals, and half-remembered routes from shore to shore.

They trade in guidance, not conquest.
journal.attuned.page27:
Tide Records

A Seafarer's best map is return.

Where a wreck sank. Where a bell was heard. Where a shard washed clean.
journal.attuned.page32:
The Offshore

After harbor lights fail, Offshore crews salvage wrecks and bargain with storms. Harpoon Focus calls a temporary Ocean Relic Trident for deep-water work. It cannot be crafted.
journal.attuned.page33:
The Revenant

The Revenant carry unfinished endings: debts, names, last roads, and grave-cold vows.

Their Foci answer death without making death cheap.
journal.attuned.page28:
Reading the HUD

The ability well shows your ready Focus Ability, the resonance bar arms Apex, and Confluence pips mark active build pairings.

Active and dormant Focus marks show what your capacity can hold.
item.attuned.stormcall_focus.lore: The sky lends its voice; you need only run.
item.attuned.stormcall_focus.effect: Calls lightning down on nearby foes while you sprint through rain.
item.attuned.gravebind_focus.lore2: You left before the door could close.
item.attuned.gravebind_focus.effect: Once a minute, a fatal blow leaves you standing at half health instead.
item.attuned.bloodfury_focus.effect: Attack speed climbs as your health falls, up to 40% faster.
item.attuned.voidstep_focus.lore: Space folds where you will it.
item.attuned.voidstep_focus.lore2: The gap closes before you leap.
item.attuned.voidstep_focus.effect: Press the Focus Ability key to blink 8 blocks forward.
item.attuned.harvest_focus.effect: Nearby crops ripen faster while you stand among them.
item.attuned.forager_focus.lore: Every hedge keeps a small kindness.
item.attuned.forager_focus.lore2: A careful hand leaves with more than leaves.
item.attuned.forager_focus.effect: Sometimes find extra seeds or food while gathering plants.
item.attuned.tremor_focus.lore2: Not a map. Only a hunch with weight.
item.attuned.tremor_focus.effect: Mining stone outlines the nearest ore vein for a short time.
item.attuned.beacon_focus.lore2: Lost is a direction, not a place.
item.attuned.beacon_focus.effect: Aims a held compass at your last bed.
item.attuned.waystone_focus.lore: A road back from the last mistake.
item.attuned.waystone_focus.lore2: The needle remembers where you fell.
item.attuned.waystone_focus.effect: A single held compass points toward your last death while active.
item.attuned.softstep_focus.lore: A step so careful the dust keeps sleeping.
item.attuned.softstep_focus.lore2: The path notices only after you have gone.
item.attuned.softstep_focus.effect: Sneak faster and become silent while crouching. Sprinting breaks the silence.
item.attuned.veil_focus.lore: A cloak made from the space between glances.
item.attuned.veil_focus.lore2: Stand still, and the world misplaces you.
item.attuned.veil_focus.effect: Crouch motionless in low light to become veiled until you move, sprint, attack, take damage, or are revealed. Focus Ability key: pulse the veil for 3 s when conditions still hold.
item.attuned.needle_focus.lore: No flourish. No warning. Only the opening.
item.attuned.needle_focus.lore2: It is sharpest before the fight begins.
item.attuned.needle_focus.effect: Your first hit from behind or from a veil deals 35% more damage, then cools down.
item.attuned.smoke_focus.lore: A held breath, let loose all at once.
item.attuned.smoke_focus.lore2: The eye follows the cloud. You follow the gap.
item.attuned.smoke_focus.effect: Press the Focus Ability key to release smoke. Mobs that have lost sight may drop target.
item.attuned.linecast_focus.lore: They carry no banner inland; the tide is witness enough.
item.attuned.linecast_focus.lore2: A patient hook remembers generous water.
item.attuned.linecast_focus.effect: Grants +1 Luck and a strong Luck of the Sea boost; fish catches may bring up extra cod.
item.attuned.netmender_focus.lore: Salt in the hinge, starlight in the glass.
item.attuned.netmender_focus.lore2: A careful knot keeps the tool from wearing thin.
item.attuned.netmender_focus.effect: Grants +1 Luck and a Luck of the Sea boost; fish catches may restore 1 rod durability.
item.attuned.harborlight_focus.lore: A dock light kept for anyone still on the water.
item.attuned.harborlight_focus.lore2: It guides without calling for war.
item.attuned.harborlight_focus.effect: Grants +1 Luck and a Luck of the Sea boost; near water in low light, holding or standing near a lantern grants night vision.
item.attuned.driftglass_focus.lore: Lost is a direction, not a verdict.
item.attuned.driftglass_focus.lore2: The tide writes the way back in glass.
item.attuned.driftglass_focus.effect: Grants +1 Luck and a Luck of the Sea boost; compasses point to your fishing or boating return point.
item.attuned.harpoon_focus.lore: After the harbor lights fail, the deep still keeps tools.
item.attuned.harpoon_focus.lore2: Storm maps, wreck rope, and a barb that remembers return.
item.attuned.harpoon_focus.effect: Press the Focus Ability key to summon a temporary Ocean Relic Trident for 30 seconds.
item.attuned.votive_focus.lore: A small flame kept in public.
item.attuned.votive_focus.lore2: Light is a promise someone else can see.
item.attuned.votive_focus.effect: In bright light or near lit candles, a hostile hit can grant a brief absorption shield.
item.attuned.bellwether_focus.lore2: Near a bell, hidden danger answers in outline.
item.attuned.bellwether_focus.effect: Ringing or standing within 8 blocks of a bell reveals visible threats for a short time.
item.attuned.oathguard_focus.lore: The shield is not a wall. It is a word kept.
item.attuned.oathguard_focus.lore2: Hold fast, and the vow holds with you.
item.attuned.oathguard_focus.effect: Blocking or taking a hostile hit can grant a brief absorption shield. Focus Ability key: witness nearby threats and knit your wounds.
item.attuned.sunlance_focus.lore: A spear of daylight with no patience for ruin.
item.attuned.sunlance_focus.lore2: It strikes only when the hand is steady.
item.attuned.sunlance_focus.effect: Fully charged melee hits deal 10% more damage to undead and Fury-aligned foes.
item.attuned.censer_focus.lore: Smoke remembers what the body should forget.
item.attuned.censer_focus.lore2: Poison loosens where the rite is kept.
item.attuned.censer_focus.effect: In bright light or near campfires, slowly trims poison and wither durations.
item.attuned.namesake_focus.lore: A true name is a small anchor against chaos.
item.attuned.namesake_focus.lore2: The world is kinder to things it can call back.
item.attuned.namesake_focus.effect: Grants +1 Luck while carrying or standing near something custom-named.
item.attuned.threshold_focus.lore2: Cross from dark into light, and the pact notices.
item.attuned.threshold_focus.effect: Moving from low light into bright light grants a brief absorption shield.
item.attuned.rootstep_focus.lore: The path listens through root and soil.
item.attuned.rootstep_focus.lore2: Walk gently, and the ground walks with you.
item.attuned.rootstep_focus.effect: On natural blocks, slightly improves movement speed and softens fall damage.
item.attuned.bloom_focus.lore: A seed is a future small enough to carry.
item.attuned.bloom_focus.lore2: Careful hands come back with more than they took.
item.attuned.bloom_focus.effect: Rarely finds seeds, flowers, or honeycomb while gathering plants.
item.attuned.mossheart_focus.lore: Old stone grows a green patience.
item.attuned.mossheart_focus.lore2: Soft things survive by yielding first.
item.attuned.mossheart_focus.effect: After a hostile hit on moss, grass, or leaves, gain Resistance I briefly, then cool down.
item.attuned.temper_focus.lore2: The blade learns restraint before hunger.
item.attuned.temper_focus.effect: After using a forge block, fully charged melee hits deal 8% more damage briefly.
item.attuned.kilnward_focus.lore: The forge is dangerous because it is useful.
item.attuned.kilnward_focus.lore2: Stand near heat and remember its terms.
item.attuned.kilnward_focus.effect: Near heat, hostile hits grant brief Resistance I. This is not fire immunity.
item.attuned.rivet_focus.lore: A small pin can hold a bridge together.
item.attuned.rivet_focus.lore2: Do not underrate the quiet fastenings.
item.attuned.rivet_focus.effect: Grants 15% knockback resistance while grounded and crouching, blocking, or standing on metal blocks.
item.attuned.mask_focus.lore: A face for the places that should not know yours.
item.attuned.mask_focus.lore2: The Unseen do not vanish. They decline to be named.
item.attuned.mask_focus.effect: After crouching in low light, briefly resist reveal and Glowing effects, except while fully veiled. Focus Ability key: instantly resist reveal for 5 s.
item.attuned.whisper_focus.lore: A sound small enough to pass beneath notice.
item.attuned.whisper_focus.lore2: Even silence has a softer setting.
item.attuned.whisper_focus.effect: Press the Focus Ability key to soften detection. Mobs that have lost sight may drop target.
item.attuned.blackout_focus.lore: The lamp goes out. The road remains.
item.attuned.blackout_focus.lore2: A hidden thing is not always lost.
item.attuned.blackout_focus.effect: Press the Focus Ability key to pulse blackout smoke. Nearby mobs are briefly blinded and drop target.
item.attuned.epitaph_focus.lore: A name carved where the road ended.
item.attuned.epitaph_focus.lore2: What was lost begins to drift home.
item.attuned.epitaph_focus.effect: Nearby experience orbs are drawn gently toward you.
item.attuned.ashen_debt_focus.lore: The wound keeps its own ledger.
item.attuned.ashen_debt_focus.effect: After a foe hurts you, your next direct melee hit against them deals 25% more damage.
item.attuned.hollowstep_focus.lore: A step taken through the space a body used to be.
item.attuned.hollowstep_focus.lore2: For a heartbeat, the grave forgets your weight.
item.attuned.hollowstep_focus.effect: Press the Focus Ability key to phase 5 blocks forward through entities, not walls.
item.attuned.last_rites_focus.lore2: Some endings wash the living too.
item.attuned.last_rites_focus.effect: Kills against hostile foes can cleanse poison, wither, slowness, or fire from you.
item.attuned.bonechill_focus.lore: Cold enough to make old bones answer.
item.attuned.bonechill_focus.effect: Undead you strike, and hostile foes that strike you, are briefly slowed.
item.attuned.gloomstride_focus.lore: The dark is not a wall. It is a road, and you know its turns.
item.attuned.gloomstride_focus.lore2: Where the light fails, your feet remember the way.
item.attuned.gloomstride_focus.effect: Move a little faster while standing in low light.
item.attuned.duskward_focus.lore: Nightfall does not leave you bare. It dresses you in shadow.
item.attuned.duskward_focus.lore2: The deeper the dusk, the harder it is to reach you.
item.attuned.duskward_focus.effect: Gain extra armor while standing in low light.
item.attuned.shadowmeld_focus.lore: Hold still in the dark and the dark holds you back.
item.attuned.shadowmeld_focus.lore2: A shape that does not move is hard to wound.
item.attuned.shadowmeld_focus.effect: Crouch in low light to gain Resistance.
item.attuned.dreadfang_focus.lore: The first bite is not the wound. It is the blindness that follows.
item.attuned.dreadfang_focus.lore2: Strike true, and your prey loses the light to find you.
item.attuned.dreadfang_focus.effect: A fully charged melee hit on a hostile foe smothers them in Darkness.
item.attuned.eclipse_focus.lore: When the last of the light is gone, something older wakes in you.
item.attuned.eclipse_focus.lore2: The total dark is not empty. It is full of teeth.
item.attuned.eclipse_focus.effect: Gain Strength while standing in total darkness (light level 4 or lower).
item.attuned.undertow_focus.lore: A hook of moonlit water, always pulling back.
item.attuned.undertow_focus.lore2: The current does not chase. It waits, then takes.
item.attuned.undertow_focus.effect: Charged melee hits slow hostile targets. Grants better movement through water.
item.attuned.riptide_heart_focus.lore: A pulse that learned its rhythm from breakers.
item.attuned.riptide_heart_focus.lore2: Every retreat is only the sea gathering itself.
item.attuned.riptide_heart_focus.effect: Keeps Speed refreshed and improves water movement.
item.attuned.pearlguard_focus.lore: A pale shield grown layer by layer around hurt.
item.attuned.pearlguard_focus.lore2: Rain finds the pearl already closed.
item.attuned.pearlguard_focus.effect: Grants armor, and Resistance while wet, underwater, or in rain. Focus Ability key: grant a brief absorption shell.
item.attuned.slagbrand_focus.lore: The waste of the furnace still remembers heat.
item.attuned.slagbrand_focus.lore2: A flawed brand can mark the strongest armor.
item.attuned.slagbrand_focus.effect: Adds melee damage. Charged melee hits weaken hostile targets.
item.attuned.anvilheart_focus.lore2: It does not move quickly. It does not need to.
item.attuned.anvilheart_focus.effect: Grants armor toughness and knockback resistance, with brief Resistance pulses.
item.attuned.sparkweld_focus.lore: Two broken edges, joined by a bright refusal.
item.attuned.sparkweld_focus.lore2: Every spark is a tiny oath to hold.
item.attuned.sparkweld_focus.effect: Increases attack speed and keeps Haste refreshed. Focus Ability key: surge with Strength for 5 s.
item.attuned.thornwake_focus.lore: Where blood falls, the briar remembers who struck first.
item.attuned.thornwake_focus.lore2: The green world has teeth. It simply grows them slowly.
item.attuned.thornwake_focus.effect: Adds armor. Charged melee hits briefly poison hostile targets.
item.attuned.seedcall_focus.lore: A dry seed that answers to your pulse.
item.attuned.seedcall_focus.lore2: Small lives gather where the song is patient.
item.attuned.seedcall_focus.effect: Grants Luck and periodic short Regeneration pulses.
item.attuned.bramblegate_focus.lore: A doorway of thorns, open only to the rooted.
item.attuned.bramblegate_focus.lore2: Those who rush it learn the shape of staying.
item.attuned.bramblegate_focus.effect: Grants knockback resistance. Charged melee hits slow hostile targets longer.
item.attuned.nullveil_focus.lore: A veil woven from the space where light should be.
item.attuned.nullveil_focus.lore2: Look away once, and it teaches the world to forget.
item.attuned.nullveil_focus.effect: Move faster while sneaking and fade with Invisibility in low light.
item.attuned.cinderthief_focus.lore: A black hand cupped around someone else's ember.
item.attuned.cinderthief_focus.lore2: It steals heat because it was born without any.
item.attuned.cinderthief_focus.effect: Adds melee damage. Charged melee hits steal a short Fire Resistance window.
item.attuned.snaremoon_focus.lore: A crescent hook hung where the road bends dark.
item.attuned.snaremoon_focus.lore2: Fast feet still cast shadows. Shadows can be caught.
item.attuned.snaremoon_focus.effect: Slightly increases movement speed. Charged melee hits heavily slow hostile targets.
item.attuned.tidewarden_focus.lore: The harbor wall does not argue with the storm.
item.attuned.tidewarden_focus.lore2: It simply stands until the storm forgets why it came.
item.attuned.wellspring_focus.lore: Some depths give more than they take.
item.attuned.wellspring_focus.lore2: Drink, and the tide replenishes what was spent.
item.attuned.wellspring_focus.effect: Grants 3 extra hearts of maximum health and improved swimming.
item.attuned.current_runner_focus.lore: Do not fight the water. Become its errand.
item.attuned.current_runner_focus.lore2: The fastest path is the one the current already wants.
item.attuned.current_runner_focus.effect: Grants +12% movement speed and far smoother movement through water.
item.attuned.saltbrand_focus.lore: Brine in the wound is its own kind of teacher.
item.attuned.saltbrand_focus.lore2: What the breaker strikes, it strikes all at once.
item.attuned.saltbrand_focus.effect: Grants +4 attack damage and +2 armor toughness.
item.attuned.ebbstride_focus.lore: The tide pulls back only to gather speed.
item.attuned.ebbstride_focus.lore2: Strike on the retreat, before the water returns.
item.attuned.ebbstride_focus.effect: Grants +15% attack speed and a softer landing from falls.
item.attuned.overgrowth_focus.lore: Bark thickens where the wound once was.
item.attuned.overgrowth_focus.lore2: The body learns to grow back faster than the world can take.
item.attuned.overgrowth_focus.effect: Grants 3 extra hearts of maximum health and +3 armor.
item.attuned.deeproot_focus.lore: What is rooted does not reckon with the wind.
item.attuned.deeproot_focus.lore2: Push, and find only the patience of stone beneath the soil.
item.attuned.deeproot_focus.effect: Grants 20% knockback resistance and +2 armor toughness.
item.attuned.briarcoat_focus.lore: A thousand small thorns, each eager to be first.
item.attuned.briarcoat_focus.lore2: The bramble does not strike once; it strikes again, and again.
item.attuned.briarcoat_focus.effect: Increases attack damage by 2 and attack speed by 0.3.
item.attuned.fernstride_focus.lore: Soft fronds underfoot, and the ground gives gladly.
item.attuned.fernstride_focus.lore2: You move as the new growth does, reaching for light.
item.attuned.fernstride_focus.effect: Increases movement speed by 12% and jump strength by 20%.
item.attuned.sapflow_focus.lore: Sap rises in spring and will not be told to stop.
item.attuned.sapflow_focus.lore2: Vigor pools in the limbs, then spends itself on the strike.
item.attuned.sapflow_focus.effect: Grants 2 extra hearts of maximum health and increases attack damage by 2.
item.attuned.cinderplate_focus.lore: Slag, hammered cold into a second skin.
item.attuned.cinderplate_focus.lore2: What the furnace rejected still turns a blade.
item.attuned.cinderplate_focus.effect: Grants +3 armor and +2 armor toughness for a slag-forged defense.
item.attuned.bellowsfury_focus.lore: The bellows draws breath; the ember answers.
item.attuned.bellowsfury_focus.lore2: Strike while the iron sings, not after.
item.attuned.bellowsfury_focus.effect: Grants +2 attack damage and 20% attack speed as the forge breathes.
item.attuned.bloodrush_focus.lore: The chase and the kill are one motion.
item.attuned.bloodrush_focus.lore2: Slowing down is how prey dies.
item.attuned.bloodrush_focus.effect: Adds +0.35 attack speed and 10% movement speed.
item.attuned.ravager_focus.lore: All the weight thrown into the swing.
item.attuned.ravager_focus.lore2: Nothing left over to brace the blow.
item.attuned.ravager_focus.effect: Increases attack damage by 40% but reduces knockback resistance by 10%.
item.attuned.granitehide_focus.lore: Skin remembers the mountain it came from.
item.attuned.granitehide_focus.lore2: What strikes you strikes stone, and stone keeps its silence.
item.attuned.hammerward_focus.lore: The wall that learned to swing back.
item.attuned.hammerward_focus.lore2: Plant your feet; let the answer be heavy.
item.attuned.hammerward_focus.effect: Grants 2 extra hearts of maximum health, 30% knockback resistance, and +2 attack damage.
item.attuned.cavewick_focus.lore: A flame taught to stay calm underground.
item.attuned.cavewick_focus.lore2: Place a light, and the cave remembers the way.
item.attuned.cavewick_focus.effect: Near placed lanterns or soul lanterns, keeps a gentle Night Vision refresh.
item.attuned.glowline_focus.lore: A thin mark of safe passage.
item.attuned.glowline_focus.lore2: The Circle leaves a line for those still catching up.
item.attuned.glowline_focus.effect: Guides you toward recent same-dimension Circle pings.
item.attuned.rescueflame_focus.lore: A breath kept for the one who has none left.
item.attuned.rescueflame_focus.lore2: The deepest dark is easier with a hand nearby.
item.attuned.rescueflame_focus.effect: Periodically assists nearby drowning Circle members with Water Breathing.
item.attuned.depthglass_focus.lore: A compass lens polished in drowned light.
item.attuned.depthglass_focus.lore2: It does not guess. It remembers the marked pull.
item.attuned.depthglass_focus.effect: A held lodestone compass provides same-dimension navigation hints while active.
item.attuned.attunement_altar.lore: Worked stone, and a hollow that remembers.
item.attuned.attunement_altar.lore2: What you bind here, the soul keeps.
item.attuned.attunement_altar.effect: Bind Attunement Shards at the Altar to raise your capacity.
item.attuned.altar_of_reweaving.lore: Worked deepslate, amethyst dust, and the patience to remember differently.
item.attuned.altar_of_reweaving.lore2: Its basin turns old patterns until they catch another light.
item.attuned.altar_of_reweaving.effect: Consumes three Foci and a Shard Fragment to reweave one new Focus.
onboarding.attuned.first_shard.detail: Bring it to an Attunement Altar to raise your capacity.
onboarding.attuned.first_fragment.found: You found an Attunement Shard Fragment.
onboarding.attuned.first_fragment.detail: Collect four, then craft them into a full shard.
onboarding.attuned.altar_sight: An Altar waits. Right-click empty-handed to open it, or with a shard to bind directly.
onboarding.attuned.first_dormant.found: Dormant Foci stay equipped but inactive.
onboarding.attuned.first_dormant.detail: Move them higher, bind shards, or hover for details.
onboarding.attuned.first_resonance_armed: Resonance crossed half full — your capstone is live.
onboarding.attuned.first_ability.detail: Press your ability key again when the ring clears.
onboarding.attuned.first_confluence.deta: Matching Foci together unlock shared bonuses — check your journal.
onboarding.attuned.pact_trial_complete.d: Your Tier 4 bonus is permanent — re-awaken the pact to claim it.
